dct_creator_sm: Walker, Branden (Wilfrid Laurier University, Cold Regions Research Centre, Wilfrid Laurier University). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0121-8170
dct_description_sm: This dataset provides a 30-metre resolution landcover classification for the Trail Valley Creek Research Watershed conducted using Landsat Series multispectral products. Landcover classifications were conducted for two periods to accompany the long-term end-of-winter snow survey records for the research domain (1991-present). Data are provided as 30m raster .tif files for the Trail Valley Creek watershed domain monitored upstream of the Water Survey of Canada stream gauge.
dct_title_s: Satellite-Derived Landcover Classifications for Trail Valley Creek Research Watershed: 1990 and 2019
